Infections of the pleural cavity. Three patients with pleural empyema or pneumonectomy space infection were treated by ir- rigation of the cavity with noxytiolin 1% in normal saline for 3 hours, followed by drainage for 1 hour, the cycle being repeated 4-hourly. Infection was eradicated within 21 days in all 3 pa- tients.1 1. Rosenfeldt FL, et al. Comparison between irrigation and conven- tional treatment for empyema and pneumonectomy space infec- tion.
